purpose: Current descriptive XLS open/list/one-cell baseline with operation allocation and source locality

counters.scope: whole process including generation, cloning, validation, reporting; not operation-local

corpus_expected.name: xls-comments-opaque-heavy
corpus_expected.opaque_identity: All opaque streams are bound by the exact archive SHA and deterministic generator; per-stream SHA vectors are not exposed by this runner.

timing_scope: Both families time fresh workbook open plus requested projection. Archive cloning, source construction, layout/oracle, postvalidation and owner drop are excluded. Source timer includes diagnostic ReadAt observation. Source/eager are separate descriptive families; no cross-family speedup.
allocation_scope: Separate counting-System allocator executable. begin immediately before Instant; finish immediately after elapsed; includes temporary and retained owner/query allocation, excludes owner drop, source construction and archive clone. Peak counters are process lifetime snapshots, not isolated operation peaks.
cache_scope: Warm in-memory generated corpus; samples share each child. Global filesystem_cache_states/fresh_child_per_sample defaults do not apply to these selectors. No filesystem or cold/remote evidence.
statistics: Per process conventional p50 (even midpoint), nearest-rank p95/p99, mean, exact distribution-free 95% binomial/order-statistic median interval; interval assumes independent observations and does not capture host drift. Report all repeats and spread separately.
read_metrics: ReadAt logical bytes/counts and classified range overlap are measured; exact request-size distribution, physical reads, syscall attribution and eager source counts are unavailable.
validation: Require clean frozen source and binary SHA; matching catalog/corpus, 6case matrix, sample permutation/timing allocation alignment, stable per-family digest, matching generated projections, zero source opaque/unselected bytes and stable version. Preserve all failed runs; no production optimization keep/reject claim.
remaining: No latency speedup, cold-file, remote, concurrent, scaling, isolated peak memory, exact LLC/L1 or broad XLS/CFB completeness claim.
